description: Which edit TmAgentPlan turned into the new step list it reports through OnPlanChanged. A host that persists or logs plan changes reads this instead of diffing two snapshots.

members.name: Add
members.description: A step was inserted at AgentPlanEdit.Index.

members.name: Remove
members.description: The step at AgentPlanEdit.Index was removed; the removed step rides in AgentPlanEdit.Step, so the host can undo it.

members.name: Reorder
members.description: A step moved from AgentPlanEdit.FromIndex to AgentPlanEdit.ToIndex.
